full_text_zh:
[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
禹杀相柳
李永凤/改编 陈伟工作室/绘
黑龙江美术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
禹杀相柳
季永凤/改编  陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] 洪水！到处都是洪水！
洪水像发怒的巨龙，四处翻滚，淹没了庄稼，
淹没了房屋，淹没了道路，淹没了山丘……
到处都是破衣烂衫、无家可归的人。

[P4] 在一片绝望的哭声中，河边走来了一群人，领头的就是大禹。大禹继承了他父亲鲧伯的遗愿，带着部下来到洪水泛滥的河边，救助百姓，治理洪水。

大禹是非常有本事的人，治水很有一套，大家都愿意跟随他一起治理洪水。
经过他们的一番努力，咆哮的洪水慢慢安静下来，自西向东，缓缓流向大海。

[P5] 老百姓高兴了，水神共工却不高兴了，他暗暗想道：“这个傲慢的大禹，治水居然都不跟我打声招呼，必须给他点儿颜色瞧瞧！”
于是，他偷偷施展神力，让洪水又上涨起来。但堤坝又高又坚固，洪水冲不出来。

[P6] “大哥，我来助你！”随着一阵“嗤嗤”声，一条蛇游了过来。
这条蛇可不是普通的蛇，而是有九个人脑袋的巨蛇！

[P7] “哈哈，相柳老弟，你来得正好！”共工开怀大笑，“快来尝尝，看这些该死的堤坝合不合你的胃口！
“那好，我最爱吃土，一次吃九座小山，也才能七分饱。”
相柳想起他吃小山时，老百姓吓得四处逃跑的情形，忍不住大笑起来。

[P8] “这次，就让我来吃个够吧！”
相柳大吼一声，声音大得像打雷。
上一秒还在地上游走的青绿色身体，
此刻盘旋起来，上升再上升，高耸
直立，同时瞪圆了十八只眼睛，冷
冷地俯视着地面。

[P9] 找好最佳的位置后，相柳的
九个脑袋一齐扑到堤坝上，九张
大嘴贪婪地吞起土来，就像在抢
着吃天底下最美味的食物。尘烟
滚滚，堤坝很快就缩短了。

[P10] “不好了，不好了！”有人慌慌张张地跑来向大禹报告，“相柳把堤坝毁了，大水又发疯啦！”
大禹他们站在一处高地，向四周望去。
堤坝已经毁了一半，被解放了的洪水又到处蔓延，老百姓只能再次逃命。

[P11] “共工是水神，我们只要抓住他送到天庭就行。倒是这个相柳，该怎么对付呢？”相柳是个凶神，大禹一时也想不出好办法。
“爷爷曾告诉我，相柳不但吃土，吃完还要往外喷水，那水不光气味恶心难闻，而且又苦又辣，如果不小心沾上一点儿，人马上就没命了，连最凶猛的野兽，也不敢在他喷出的水边晃悠。”
一个小孩儿害怕地嚷道。

[P12] “怎样才能制住相柳呢？”大禹摸着下巴，低头走来走去，苦苦思索。
“别想了，咱们团结起来杀掉相柳吧。”这时，应龙飞到大禹身边大声说道。“好，兄弟们，那咱们就放手一搏，杀掉凶神相柳！”大禹抬起头坚定地说。
兵分两路：伯夷带领一支队伍，负责把共工引开；
大禹坐在应龙背上，领着九条龙，直奔相柳。

[P13] 相柳吃得肚子发胀，刚想起身舒展下身体，就发现自己被九条龙包围了。
九条龙在空中快速飞舞，搅起了一股龙卷风，相柳的九个脑袋忽上忽下，忽左忽右，很快就晕晕乎乎，辨不清方向了。
这时候，应龙从天而降，背上的大禹手持神斧，大喝一声，给了相柳全力一击！

[P14] 相柳死了！流了好多好多血！
他的血腥臭无比，血流过的土地，
再也长不出庄稼了，连杂草都没了。

[P15] 相柳庞大的身躯倒下去，变成了有毒的大沼泽。
人们根本无法靠近，只能又害怕又生气地抱怨着：“这个大凶神，死了还要祸害我们。”

[P16] 大禹派人往沼泽地里加土，结果土马上陷了进去；
继续加土，还是不断下陷；
一次又一次填土，沼泽地就像填不满的窟窿，
土一进去就消失得无影无踪……

[P17] “干脆把它挖成大池塘吧。”
聪明的大禹决定把填土改为挖土。

“大禹来喽，相柳走喽！”
老百姓们在池塘边高兴地唱歌、
跳舞，感谢大禹为他们做的一切。
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Chinese Classic Mythological Stories
Yu Kills Xiangliu
Adapted by Li Yongfeng, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Heilongjiang Fine Arts Publishing House

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythological Story Picture Book
Yu Kills Xiangliu
Adapted by Ji Yongfeng, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] Flood! Everywhere is flood!
Floods, like furious dragons, surge everywhere, drowning crops,
drowning houses, drowning roads, drowning hills...
Everywhere are people in tattered clothes, homeless.

[P4] Amidst cries of despair, a group of people came to the riverbank, led by Dayu. Dayu inherited his father Gun's wish, bringing his followers to the flood-stricken river to rescue the people and manage the floods.

Dayu was a very capable man, skilled in flood control, and everyone was willing to follow him in managing the floods.
After their efforts, the roaring floodwaters gradually calmed down, flowing slowly from west to east toward the sea.

[P5] The people were happy, but the water god Gonggong was not. He secretly thought, "This arrogant Dayu, how dare he control the floods without even saying hello to me? I must give him a taste of his own medicine!"
So, he secretly used his divine power to make the floods rise again. But the embankment was high and strong, and the floodwaters could not break through.

[P6] "Big brother, I'm here to help you!" With a series of 'hiss hiss' sounds, a snake swam over.
This snake was no ordinary snake—it was a giant serpent with nine human heads!

[P7] "Ha ha, younger brother Xiangliu, you've come just in time!" Gonggong laughed heartily, "Come and try these damned dikes—see if they suit your appetite!"
"Very well, I love eating earth most. I need to eat nine small hills at once to feel only seven-tenths full."
Xiangliu recalled the scene when he ate the hills, and how the common people were terrified and ran in all directions. He couldn't help but burst into laughter.

[P8] "This time, let me eat my fill!"
Xiangliu roared, his voice loud as thunder.
The emerald-green body that had just been slithering on the ground now coiled up, rising higher and higher, standing tall, its eighteen eyes wide open, coldly overlooking the earth.

[P9] After finding the best position, Xiangliu's
nine heads rushed together onto the dike, nine
big mouths greedily swallowing the soil, as if
racing to eat the most delicious food under heaven. Dust
rose in waves, and the dike quickly shortened.

[P10] "Oh no, oh no!" Someone ran frantically to report to Dayu, "Xiangliu has destroyed the dike, and the floodwaters have gone mad again!"
Dayu and his companions stood on a high ground, looking around.
The dike had already been destroyed halfway; the unleashed floodwaters spread everywhere again, and the common people could only flee for their lives.

[P11] "Gonggong is the water god. If we can just catch him and send him to the Heavenly Court, we'll be fine. But what about Xiangliu? How do we deal with him?" Xiangliu is a fierce demon, and Dayu couldn't think of a good solution at the moment.
"Grandpa told me that Xiangliu not only eats soil, but after eating, he spits out water. That water not only smells terrible and foul, but is also bitter and spicy. If you accidentally get even a little on you, you'll die instantly. Even the fiercest beasts dare not linger near the water he spits out."
A little child cried out in fear.

[P12] "How can we subdue Xiangliu?" Da Yu stroked his chin, looking down and pacing back and forth, deep in thought.
"Forget it, let's unite and kill Xiangliu!" At that moment, Yinglong flew to Da Yu's side and shouted. "Alright, brothers, let's go all out and kill the evil spirit Xiangliu!" Da Yu raised his head and said firmly.
Divide into two groups: Bo Yi leads one team to lure Gonggong away;
Da Yu rides on Yinglong's back, leading nine dragons straight toward Xiangliu.

[P13] Xiangliu, having eaten until his belly swelled, tried to rise and stretch his body, only to find himself surrounded by nine dragons.
The nine dragons darted swiftly through the air, stirring up a whirlwind. Xiangliu's nine heads bobbed up and down, left and right, soon becoming dizzy and disoriented.
At that moment, Yinglong descended from the sky. On his back, Dayu held his divine axe, roared loudly, and delivered a full-force strike to Xiangliu!

[P14] Xiangliu is dead! He bled so much!
His blood is terribly foul-smelling. The land where his blood flowed
will never grow crops again, not even weeds.

[P15] Xiangliu's massive body fell down, turning into a toxic marsh.
People could not approach at all, and could only complain in fear and anger: "This great demon, even after death, still brings disaster upon us."

[P16] Yu sent people to add soil into the marsh, but the soil sank in immediately;
Continuing to add soil, it still kept sinking;
Time after time, they filled the marsh, which seemed like an endless hole,
As soon as the soil went in, it vanished without a trace...

[P17] "Let's dig it into a big pond instead."
Clever Yu the Great decided to change filling the land with soil to digging it out.

"Yu the Great is here, Xiangliu is gone!"
The common people sang and danced happily by the pond, thanking Yu the Great for everything he had done for them.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《禹杀相柳》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及一位在洪水中痛苦挣扎的孩童形象，背景是汹涌的波涛。
[P2] 本页为绘本《禹杀相柳》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及一位手持武器与多头蛇怪搏斗的英雄形象，背景充满动感，暗示了故事的紧张氛围。
[P3] 本页描绘了洪水肆虐的惨状，一个孩子在洪水中痛苦挣扎，文字描述洪水如巨龙般吞噬庄稼、房屋、道路和山丘，导致人们流离失所。
[P4] 大禹带领部下来到洪水泛滥的河边，救助百姓并治理洪水，凭借其治水才能，最终使洪水逐渐平息，流向大海。
[P5] 水神共工因大禹治水未向他打招呼而心生不满，暗中施展神力使洪水再次上涨，但坚固的堤坝阻止了洪水冲破。
[P6] 一条九头巨蛇从水中游来，声称要帮助大禹，但其外形凶恶，暗示其真实意图可能并不友好。
[P7] 共工召唤九头蛇相柳来破坏大禹修建的堤坝，相柳表示自己爱吃土，并回忆起吃山时百姓惊慌逃跑的情景，两人相视大笑，气氛充满恶意。
[P8] 九头蛇相柳发出咆哮，其青绿色的身体盘旋而起，高耸直立，用十八只眼睛冷冷俯视大地，展现出凶猛的姿态。
[P9] 九头蛇相柳扑向堤坝，用九张大嘴贪婪地吞食泥土，导致堤坝迅速缩短，大禹在旁无力阻止。
[P10] 九头蛇相柳破坏了大禹修建的堤坝，洪水再次肆虐，百姓被迫逃离，大禹等人站在高处目睹灾情。
[P11] 大禹面对九头蛇相柳的威胁一筹莫展，一个小孩儿讲述了相柳喷出的水剧毒且致命，众人对此感到恐惧。
[P12] 大禹面对九头蛇相柳的威胁陷入苦思，应龙提议团结对抗，大禹决定兵分两路，自己骑着应龙带领九条龙直奔相柳，准备决战。
[P13] 大禹骑着应龙，率领九条龙围攻九头蛇相柳，利用龙卷风使其晕眩，随后大禹挥动神斧，对相柳发动了全力一击。
[P14] 九头蛇相柳被击败后倒地身亡，其血液腥臭无比，污染了土地，导致寸草不生。
[P15] 九头蛇相柳被击败后倒下，其尸体化为有毒沼泽，人们因无法靠近而恐惧愤怒地抱怨其死后仍祸害人间。
[P16] 大禹派人试图用土填平相柳尸体化成的有毒沼泽，但土一填入便迅速下陷，无法填满，众人陷入困境。
[P17] 大禹决定将相柳尸体化成的有毒沼泽挖成池塘，百姓们在池塘边欢庆，感谢大禹的智慧与功绩。
[P18] 画面中，大禹手持神斧，与一位男子和一个小男孩站在山崖边，背景是被破坏的山体，三人似乎在商议对策，表情凝重。
